shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
horizontal band or register of repeated motifs
incised linear detailing suggesting garments or headdress
justification: Both are worked stone bearing shallow relief in which a standing human-like figure appears above or beside horizontal registers of repeated ornament, and both use incised line to suggest headgear and drapery-like texture. But A is a single free-standing, heavily weathered block whose motifs (concentric disc, curved bands) are bold, symmetrical and abstracted around one frontal figure, while B is an architectural staircase whose reliefs are crisp, finely ruled, profile-oriented and subordinated to long horizontal courses, so the compositional logic and carving manner differ fundamentally.
